name: shim-cli
description: Local sensitive-data detection and reporting for coding agents, from shim Engineering.

plugins.name: shim-cli
plugins.description: Masks secrets and personal data in the tool results Claude Code reads, before the model sees them; reports what was in your prompts; and, with `shim watch`, shows what a session sent and what it cost. Runs locally with no account, network destination or telemetry.
